summary: Prettier config package executes obfuscated payload via install-time Bun runtime download
details: @ornikar/prettier-config@9.0.4 is advertised as a Prettier configuration package but ships an obfuscated preinstall script (setup.mjs, referenced from package.json scripts.preinstall as `node setup.mjs`) that, at npm install time, downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled CommonJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a shuffled string-lookup array, hex-mangled identifiers, and control-flow flattening. Its contents are opaque and unrelated to Prettier configuration. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching an alien language runtime at install time specifically to execute a bundled, obfuscated payload that Node-based scanners cannot introspect. The delivery mechanism (unconditional preinstall) causes the payload to run automatically on `npm install` with the installing user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
